prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
**BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed person in Kansas City, MO. It says it helps Missouri residents compare ACA Marketplace plans, estimate subsidies, and check whether doctors are in-network. Its site reports a 5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews and includes a testimonial from a 1099 contractor who got help finding Marketplace coverage. The office is in North Kansas City, just across the river from downtown. [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/service-areas/kansas-city/)

I’d treat that as a promising lead, not a definitive “best”: ratings and testimonials are not a substitute for checking which plans the broker can offer. When you call, ask whether they compare **all** HealthCare.gov plans available for your ZIP code, whether their help is free, and whether they’ll check your doctors and prescriptions before you enroll.

You can also compare plans or enroll directly at [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/). Missouri uses the federal Marketplace, and self-employed people may qualify for income-based savings.
